summary.oneLiner: Q1FY26 revenue stabilized YoY despite monsoon headwinds, with EBITDA margin down to 10.1% due to pricing pressure, but management expects 8-10% top-line growth and margin recovery in FY26 driven by stabilized raw material costs and non-asbestos product ramp-up.

one-line thesis: Q1FY26 revenue stabilized YoY despite monsoon headwinds, with EBITDA margin down to 10.1% due to pricing pressure, but management expects 8-10% top-line growth and margin recovery in FY26 driven by stabilized raw material costs and non-asbestos product ramp-up.
financial scorecard: Revenue: 216.1 Cr (-0.8% YoY); EBITDA: 21.7 Cr (-12.7% YoY, margin 10.1% vs 11.4% YoY); PAT: 10.8 Cr (-13.8% YoY, margin 5% vs 5.7% YoY); Order book: not disclosed; Net debt: not disclosed
guidance: Revenue growth: 8-10% for FY26; Margin: expected to improve from FY25 levels; Order inflow: not specified; Capex/commissioning: Rs. 100 Cr total for Palghar expansion, Rs. 50 Cr spent, full commissioning by Q4FY27
segment / subsidiary detail: Asbestos roofing: core business, impacted by import costs and rural demand; Non-asbestos: fireproof/waterproof product line in early stage, targeted for significant growth over 3-4 years
growth verticals / optionality: Non-asbestos product line (fireproof/waterproof sheets) represents long-term substitution opportunity away from asbestos, with potential to double current revenue share in 3-4 years
margins & cost dynamics: EBITDA margin fell to 10.1% YoY due to imported asbestos fiber costs, rupee depreciation, and inability to fully pass on price increases; management expects stabilization and margin recovery in FY26
capex / expansion: Rs. 100 Cr total for Palghar expansion; Rs. 50 Cr already spent; remaining Rs. 50 Cr to be deployed by Q4FY27; no other capex mentioned
capital allocation: Prioritizing capex for Palghar expansion; no mention of dividends, buybacks, or debt reduction
risks & watch-items: Continued volatility in imported asbestos fiber prices; rupee depreciation; regulatory scrutiny on asbestos; slow adoption of non-asbestos products; land acquisition delays for expansion
management quality / tone: Cautiously optimistic; acknowledges headwinds but emphasizes stabilization of input costs and margin recovery potential; vague on quantitative guidance beyond top-line 8-10% and margin improvement
non-obvious takeaways: Management admits non-asbestos product is 'future product' with no current revenue breakdown, yet expects it to 'double' in 3-4 years — implies current non-asbestos revenue is likely <5% of total
